title: Rick Ross Receives His Flowers From 2 Chainz [Watch]
htmlContent:
This weekend is Rick Ross's annual Massive Car show at 'Promised Land,' which featured entertainment heavyweights such as Trick Daddy, Currency, and Rick Ross, all showed their car collection.

After the car show on Saturday, Ross's peer, 2 Chainz, elected to give Rick Ross his flowers while he is still here.

"Please let me give you your roses while you can still smile them. From peer to peer I really want you to know, that you are a motherf***ing G.O.A.T. The s*** I just... I'm talking about that G.O.A.T s*** I'm not talking about no bars and no beats... The s*** I just seen walk through this motherf***... I've been you to your 'Promised Land," said 2 Chainz.

"Man, the man has dentist out here, the man is selling jewelry out here. There's so much networking out here, n*** that do clothes out here, n*** that do rims out here. Homie you a G.O.A.T. You don't have to rap another syllable boy. You just rap because you love to do that. Don't worry about nothing you G.O.A.T.E.D yourself today. From peer to peer!"

Speaking of 2 Chainz, he was spotted in Dallas to watch game 3 of the Western Conference Finals between the Dallas Mavericks and Golden State Warriors.
